BiblicalUsage: Patsach means to break forth in joyful sound, to sing aloud. Isaiah calls the mountains to break forth into singing in Isaiah 44:23, and the heavens to sing in Isaiah 49:13. The waste places of Jerusalem are told to break forth into joy in Isaiah 52:9, and the barren woman to break forth into singing in Isaiah 54:1. Psalm 98:4 says, make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth, make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the breaking forth is the sound of redemption: mountains, heavens, waste places, and barren women all singing at once. That is why I hold that joy is not the decoration of the gospel, it is the noise it makes.
